gbifID.description: Globally unique GBIF occurrence identifier assigned to each record.

datasetKey.description: Unique identifier linking all records to the same dataset instance.

occurrenceID.description: Unique observation URLs linking to iNaturalist records for each Dioctria linearis sighting.

kingdom.description: Taxonomic kingdom classification, always Animalia for these records.

phylum.description: Taxonomic phylum of the organism, consistently Arthropoda.

class.description: Taxonomic class of the organism, consistently Insecta.

order.description: Taxonomic order of the species, consistently Diptera.

family.description: Family classification for all records, consistently Asilidae.

genus.description: Taxonomic genus of the recorded species, consistently Dioctria.

species.description: Scientific name of the observed species, consistently Dioctria linearis.

infraspecificEpithet.description: Infraspecific epithet field, currently empty for all records.

taxonRank.description: Taxonomic rank of the record, consistently SPECIES.

scientificName.description: Scientific name of the recorded Dioctria linearis species, including author citation.

verbatimScientificName.description: Scientific name of the species recorded for each occurrence.

verbatimScientificNameAuthorship.description: Original authorship citation of the scientific name as recorded

countryCode.description: Two‑letter ISO codes identifying the nation where each occurrence was recorded.

locality.description: Locality information is missing for all records.

stateProvince.description: Administrative region where each observation was recorded.

occurrenceStatus.description: All records denote species presence at the observation site.

individualCount.description: Number of observed individuals per occurrence record.

publishingOrgKey.description: Identifier of the organization that published the occurrence record.

decimalLatitude.description: Geographic latitude in decimal degrees for each occurrence record.

decimalLongitude.description: Geographic longitude in decimal degrees for each occurrence record.

coordinateUncertaintyInMeters.description: Spatial uncertainty of occurrence coordinates measured in meters.

coordinatePrecision.description: Coordinate precision is unspecified for all records.

elevation.description: Elevation values are missing for all records.

elevationAccuracy.description: Elevation accuracy data not provided in this dataset.

depth.description: Depth values are unavailable for all records.

depthAccuracy.description: Depth accuracy is missing for all occurrence records.

eventDate.description: Observation date and time of each record.

day.description: Day of month when the observation was recorded.

year.description: Calendar year of the observation, ranging from 2005 to 2026.

taxonKey.description: Taxonomic identifier for Dioctria linearis records, constant across all entries.

speciesKey.description: Unique taxonomic identifier for all Dioctria linearis occurrence records.

institutionCode.description: Data source identifier for occurrence records, consistently iNaturalist.

collectionCode.description: All records are classified under the observation collection type.

catalogNumber.description: Unique numeric identifier assigned to each occurrence record.

recordNumber.description: No data recorded for this field.

identifiedBy.description: Names of individuals who identified the Dioctria linearis specimens.

dateIdentified.description: Date and time when the specimen was identified.

license.description: License type for occurrence record, using Creative Commons variants.

rightsHolder.description: Rights holder names of individuals or organizations providing occurrence data.

recordedBy.description: Names of individuals who recorded each occurrence observation.

typeStatus.description: No recorded type status information for any occurrence.

establishmentMeans.description: Establishment means field is entirely missing in this dataset.

lastInterpreted.description: Timestamp of last data interpretation for each occurrence record.

mediaType.description: Media format associated with each occurrence record.

issue.description: Data quality issues flagged during record processing.

description: Records of Dioctria linearis occurrences from 2006 to 2026, supporting biodiversity monitoring.
